scope: Completed CPU-only expansion cases 29 through 32; inspected scanner RGB H&E, virtual DAPI/StarDist overlay, CK and CD68, and all 23 spatial channels of the one automated-QC pass

reviewed_cases.visual_observation: In a dense kidney field, many nuclei are bright but virtual DAPI is broad across adjacent cells. Boundary contrast is 0.039, below the fixed gate.
The breast field has plausible nuclear-rich signal, but many StarDist outlines are embedded in diffuse virtual DAPI. AUC 0.719 and boundary contrast 0.046 do not jointly pass the frozen gate.

This small kidney field passes the numerical DAPI, spatial-shadow and all-channel seam checks. Virtual DAPI overlaps several StarDist nuclei, and no obvious tiling seam appears. The 23 display-stretched virtual channels look unusually similar, including TRITC and Cy5. This visual impression requires comparison with native scores and historical pass fields before using the case for cell typing.

native_channel_specificity.interpretation: High shared spatial signal, within the historical 47-field range. This cannot independently reject or validate a marker; it reinforces the hold for protein-specific evidence.

reviewed_cases.visual_observation: The breast field contains H&E nuclei next to erythrocytes, whereas virtual DAPI has broad bright tissue and several nuclei with weak signal. AUC 0.621 and contrast 0.019 fail.

limits: The single automated-QC pass is a sparse training field with 19 expert nuclei; it is not a test-set accuracy result. Protein-specific validity has not been established. The other three cases remain excluded by frozen QC.
